ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If in the food web shown in the diagram, Douglas fir tree needles are absent, which organism would starve?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a food web, containing organisms such as cougar, Spotted owl, Red tree vole, Winter wren, and multiple food sources. In the lower right of the picture, an image of fir tree needles labeled “Douglas fir tree needles” can be seen; from this needle there is an arrow pointing upward to the organism labeled “Red tree vole”. Reasoning: The arrows in the food web indicate that food or energy flows from the food source to the eater. Therefore, Douglas fir tree needles are the food source of Red tree vole. If Douglas fir tree needles are missing, the Red tree vole that directly depends on them will go hungry.
